entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Interviewing people already,[n][fName]?
What are you doing here?
You learn anything?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I thought it would be wise to gather some[n]more clues before asking around at Kosei.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I tried to obtain intel at the station[n]on my way home, but couldn't gain[n]anything notable.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I investigated inside the station,[n]but failed to gain anything notable.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I was hoping to gather clues before[n]I asked around at Kosei though,[n]so I'm a tad disappointed.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...However, I did make one discovery.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The food stores underground are[n]superb. The free sample corner is[n]a veritable treasure trove.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yusuke has sauce on his face...[n]He's really something, huh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ah well. We should leave this place to him.[n]Let's go look somewhere else.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'll poke around a tad more today,[n]then inquire at Kosei tomorrow.[n]For now though, I should go home.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah, [fName]. I was just about to leave.
Do you have any information?
Anything new?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Only that the police have been[n]active recently...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: One of my peers from Kosei was stopped[n]by a policeman just the other day.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Given that they've been actively warning[n]students, it seems students must be the[n]primary victims.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm going to go ask around once more[n]before I head home.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We are low on time, yet we cannot[n]afford to be hasty. Try not to push[n]yourself too hard.

entries.speaker: Patrolling Policeman
entries.en: Oh, that uniform. You're a Shujin[n]student, aren't you?

entries.speaker: Patrolling Policeman
entries.en: Haven't you heard about the recent[n]incidents? You should run on home[n]if you want to avoid all that.
What kind of incidents?
But I have stuff to do...

entries.speaker: Patrolling Officer
entries.en: Extortions, muggings, and just general[n]scams even. Be careful of any suspicious[n]sales tactics.

entries.speaker: Patrolling Officer
entries.en: Well, be sure to go home right after that.[n]You don't want to fall prey to these scams.

entries.speaker: Patrolling Officer
entries.en: A lot of the victims have been teenagers[n]as well. Central Street is particularly[n]dangerous.

entries.speaker: Patrolling Officer
entries.en: I actually just warned another Shujin[n]student. If you see any more, tell them[n]to leave at once.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, he said he saw a Shujin student here!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Maybe we can try asking them questions![n]Come on, let's head over to Central Street!

entries.speaker: Patrolling Officer
entries.en: *sigh* There are too many kids for me[n]to warn them all... Aren't the schools[n]telling them anything...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, we should go before he starts[n]talking to us again.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He said he saw someone from your[n]school, right? Let's go look for them[n]on Central Street.

entries.speaker: Gossiping Kosei Student
entries.en: What do you want to do today?[n]How about an arcade?

entries.speaker: Carefree Kosei Student
entries.en: I'll need to grab some cash either way.[n]Let's drop by a convenience store real[n]quick.

entries.speaker: Gossiping Kosei Student
entries.en: Yeah, just make sure you're not carrying[n]a lot of money. I heard there have been[n]lots of muggings.

entries.speaker: Carefree Kosei Student
entries.en: You mean the mafia, right?[n]Central Street kinda scares me...

entries.speaker: Gossiping Kosei Student
entries.en: Central Street might be dangerous,[n]but it's not like there's anywhere else[n]for us to hang out.

entries.speaker: Carefree Kosei Student
entries.en: I'm sure it's fine during the day.[n]The mafia's probably still sleeping[n]anyway.

entries.speaker: Messy-Haired Man
entries.en: Can I help you?

entries.speaker: Messy-Haired Man
entries.en: It's been dangerous around these[n]parts lately, hasn't it? Go on home[n]before it gets dark.

entries.speaker: Messy-Haired Man
entries.en: There sure are a lot of young people[n]in Shibuya. Always have been, always[n]will be.
